Elaine (docs): Hey team — I'm opening a small PR to add an "airgapped dependency checklist" and a one-page cheat sheet for offline installs. Can infra/security confirm the package list we should recommend for RHEL/Ubuntu, and any HSM/KMS runtime libs we must call out?

Ben (eng): +1. For Ubuntu: ca-certificates, tzdata, systemd, curl, tar, gzip, openssl. For RHEL: ca-certificates, tzdata, nss, yum-utils.

Mike (infra): Also need PKCS#11 / smartcard stacks for HSMs: pcsc-lite (pcscd), opensc, libpcsclite, pkcs11-helper. On some appliances we also add libengine-pkcs11-openssl. Recommend listing package names per distro.

Ben (eng): We should call out "non-obvious" deps too: libseccomp, iproute2, and for containerized offline installer include container runtime tools (crictl, ctr) if the customer is using cri.

Mike (infra): Quick example snippets for the cheat sheet — mirroring apt & RPM, and checksum generation. Put these verbatim in docs: 

```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu mirror using debmirror (example)
sudo debmirror --arch=amd64 --dist=bionic,${DIST2} --section=main,restricted,universe,multiverse \
  --method=rsync --host=archive.ubuntu.com --root=/ubuntu /var/mirror/ubuntu

# RPM mirror example (rsync)
rsync -avz rsync://mirror.centos.org/centos/7/ /var/mirror/centos/7/

# Create checksums for tarballs to ship with offline bundle
sha256sum redwood-offline-installer-1.2.3.tar.gz > redwood-offline-installer-1.2.3.sha256
```

Elaine (docs): Good, can you also add a short verification checklist for installers to run after import (CA bundle present, cert chain verification, pkcs11 module load test)? A couple of one-line commands would be helpful.

Mike (infra): Sure. Add these to the end: 

```bash
# verify CA bundle is trusted (openssl simple check)
openssl s_client -connect private-repo.local:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject

# verify pkcs11 module loads (example using pkcs11-tool)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so -L
```

Robin (security): Small ask from security: add a short note that FIPS-mode environments may require different RPM/DEB package variants and that customers should engage support for a FIPS-validated bundle. Also call out that HSM drivers often need kernel modules or vendor-specific RPMs — list that as "vendor specific" and link to vendor docs.

Elaine (docs): Got it. I'll add a FIPS note and vendor-driver caveat. Also planning a small table: distro -> required packages -> optional packages (HSM/KMS).

deploy-bot: PR #3246 updated (files changed: docs/airgap/deps-cheatsheet.md).

Elaine (docs): Thanks — I'll push an update with distro tables + snippets above and request review from @Ben and @Mike. If anyone thinks of more edge cases (win server, selinux module changes, or container runtime variants), drop them here or add a comment in the PR. :thumbsup:
